description: Joel's ties to Cicely deepen after his old life changes without him. Spring fever, romance, local ritual and increasingly surreal accidents draw him further into a community whose logic he still resists even as he starts depending on it.

s02e01.description: A new satellite dish mesmerizes Shelly while Joel receives a devastating breakup letter from Elaine and struggles to accept that his old New York future has moved on.

s02e02.description: Ed seeks spiritual help to learn who his parents were, while Chris mysteriously loses his voice after meeting a beautiful stranger and searches for an equally unusual cure.

s02e03.description: Holling considers circumcision for Shelly, Maggie invents an elaborate lie for her visiting father, and Cicely gathers to keep vigil over an unidentified dead man.

s02e04.description: Maggie's dream of Joel dying makes him question a trip home and the doctor covering for him, while Maurice enjoys the attention of an astronaut admirer.

s02e05.description: Cicely's spring thaw sends desire into overdrive: Joel and Maggie invade each other's dreams, Maurice falls for Officer Semanski and Shelly becomes obsessed with romantic literature.

s02e06.description: Russian celebrity Nikolai returns for gifts, chess and an old feud with Maurice, while Chris secretly supplies the romantic prose Ed uses to woo Light Feather.

s02e07.description: Maggie's boyfriend Rick is killed by a falling satellite, while a gay couple tests Maurice's prejudices and Holling's old female friend stirs Shelly's jealousy.
